spec_match.rationale: Each pipeline step quotes the spec's joinGroup()/leaveGroup() method steps in order (invalid IP, non-multicast group, the three sourceAddress sub-checks, duplicate membership, closed socket, OS NetworkError) with the explainer-sourced ASM/SSM mixing rule explicitly attributed to the explainer.

interactive.rationale: Free-form group/source inputs, a method select, closed-socket and OS-failure toggles, eight example traps, and a run button drive a per-step verdict list, an exception verdict, and a persistent modelled membership table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises family mismatches, duplicates, mixing and wrong-source leaves stopping at named steps with named exceptions; all exercised and verified.

edge_cases.rationale: This IS the edge concept: TypeError (parse, non-multicast, loopback/unspecified/multicast source, family mismatch), InvalidStateError (duplicate, mixing, not-found leave, closed socket), NetworkError (OS failure, labelled a rejection not a throw), plus the SSM-range convention flagged without being enforced and the bench's own IPv6 parser limitation disclosed in the output.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6208452397498368, the joinGroup spec anchor, and the explainer's MulticastController section.

conformance.rationale: The suite covers the surface being modelled and its manual assertion records exactly why live validation cannot run here; verified executing on /conformance/ (1/6/1 on Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141 full sequence: valid SSM join resolved into the membership table → identical join stopped as InvalidStateError duplicate → source-less join on the same group stopped as InvalidStateError mixing → leaveGroup with the wrong source stopped as not-found → correct leave resolved and emptied the table → loopback source TypeError → closed-socket InvalidStateError → OS-failure NetworkError; family-mismatch autorun screenshotted; 7 step items rendered; zero console errors; overflow 0 at both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts bench-steps-ran with the method, inputs and outcome on every run, plus the honesty probe and model-only branch on load.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; step verdicts use emerald-dark/rose/muted on paper (all AA); example and run buttons pair background with color; the MODEL tag matches the lab's.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled text inputs and select, 44px example buttons, the step list is an ordered list with per-step verdict text, the final verdict is an aria-live output, and the membership table is captioned with scoped headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Inputs and example buttons wrap, the membership table scrolls in its wrapper; measured overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Cross-check the modelled pipeline against a real implementation when one ships
openQuestions.detail: The step order and exception types mirror today's spec text. When Chrome ships SSM behind the flag (target ~160), run the same inputs against a real MulticastController in an IWA and reconcile any divergence — in the page's model, or by flagging the spec step as changed for a human to review. Note the spec steps do not currently state the explainer's mixing rule; if the spec adopts or drops it, update the step's attribution.

openQuestions.title: IPv6 parser accepts only hex-group syntax
openQuestions.detail: The bench's parser handles grouped/:: forms but not embedded IPv4 (::ffff:1.2.3.4) or zone indices; the limitation is disclosed in the verdict output. Extend the parser if visitors hit it.

guidanceConsulted.query: validating free-form text input with clear inline error feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Validate on explicit action, keep inputs labelled, and present errors as text near the control with programmatic announcement.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Validation runs on the Run button (or example load), every failure renders as the stopping step plus an aria-live verdict naming the exception; inputs have visible labels and spellcheck/autocomplete off for addresses.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce validation result including exception type to screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Mirror visual error state with a programmatic announcement after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict <output aria-live="polite"> carries the exception name and reason; step-level detail is plain list text reachable in reading order.

guidanceConsulted.query: wrapping input rows and button shelves at 360px
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flex-wrap control rows and cap input widths with min()/ch so nothing forces overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The input row and example shelf are flex-wrap containers with ch-based input widths; measured 0 overflow at 360×740 DPR3.

summary: Edge/failure concept: the spec's validation pipeline made executable as a labelled model — every trap input stops at the quoted step with the exact exception, stateful enough to demonstrate duplicates, ASM/SSM mixing and wrong-source leaves, with the bench's own limitations disclosed.
